job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy AI models using deep learning techniques such as generative adversarial networks (GANs) and transformers.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate computer vision solutions into existing systems.
Develop high-quality code in Python using popular libraries like PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Troubleshoot complex issues related to image processing, machine learning algorithms, and data preprocessing.

Job Requirements :

4-6 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence Engineering with expertise in computer vision and machine learning.
Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python and familiarity with popular frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Experience working on projects involving image processing, machine learning, or deep learning is essential.
